name: layerwright-monorepo

scripts.build: npm run sync:skill && npm run build -w @cde/figma-plugin && npm run build -w layerwright
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/html-import && tsc -p apps/mcp-server && tsc -p apps/figma-plugin
scripts.test: LAYERWRIGHT_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 node --import tsx --test --test-timeout=120000 packages/core/test/*.test.ts packages/html-import/test/*.test.ts apps/mcp-server/test/*.test.ts apps/figma-plugin/test/*.test.ts

description: Layerwright monorepo: HTML/Claude Design to editable Figma, MCP server + Figma plugin
